top_signals.title: Stocks Rise at Start of CPI Week; Iran's Hormuz Deal Elusive | Bloomberg Brief 08/10/2026
top_signals.summary: US equity futures rally after the payrolls report showed a sharp slowdown in the labor market, driving stocks to a fresh record high. Oil advances as Iran's accord with Oman on the Hormuz shipping route remains elusive. TSMC posts a 45% rise in monthly sales amid strong demand for AI hardware. Thierry Wizman of Macquarie Group looks ahead to the inflation data. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Hormuz Deal Remains Elusive, Stocks Hold Near Record Highs | The Opening Trade 8/10/2026
top_signals.summary:
Stocks traded near record highs, with Asian shares mirroring Friday’s gains on Wall Street after weak US jobs data curbed bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes. Oil traded around $83 a barrel as a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remained elusive.

An agreement with Oman to establish a shipping route through Hormuz was “very close,” Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said over the weekend. He ruled out direct talks with the US for now because of violations of an interim peace deal reached in June.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
